python3 -c "
import re, yaml, json, sys
text = open('journals/2026-08-19-chaos-toggle-products-503.md').read()
m = re.match(r'^---\n(.*?)\n---\n', text, re.DOTALL)
fm = yaml.safe_load(m.group(1))
print('YAML parses OK')
print('Top-level keys:', list(fm.keys()))
print('hypotheses ids:', [h['id'] for h in fm['hypotheses']])
print('evidence ids:', [e['id'] for e in fm['evidence']])
refs = set()
for h in fm['hypotheses']:
    refs.update(h['evidence_for']); refs.update(h['evidence_against'])
evids = set(e['id'] for e in fm['evidence'])
print('unresolved refs:', refs - evids)
print('unused evidence:', evids - refs)
try:
    import jsonschema
    schema = json.load(open('.claude/skills/investigate/journal.schema.json'))
    jsonschema.validate(fm, schema)
    print('SCHEMA VALID')
except ImportError:
    print('jsonschema not installed, skipping strict validation')
except Exception as ex:
    print('SCHEMA ERROR:', ex)
"
